text: The dashboard's page is never wider than its window (#888). A chip in a model's row kept to one line above a phone's width, so a long one reached past the page's edge, by 53 pixels in a window of 900, 78 in one of 874 and 179 in one of 768. The page hides what's past its edge and shows no sideways scrollbar, but a focus, find-in-page or a scroll into view could move it there, header and all, and nothing a reader did brought it back but reading the page again. Found while checking #886 in a real window 874 pixels wide. A chip that's longer than its row now wraps at every width.
